name: Systeme.io
category: Funnels, courses and email marketing platform
oneLiner: Sales funnels, email marketing, online courses, communities and a store in one account, with 0% transaction fees and a free plan for up to 2,000 contacts.
summary: Systeme.io combines sales funnels, email marketing with unlimited sends, online courses, communities, websites and blogs, a booking calendar and an affiliate-program manager in one account. Plans are tiered mainly by contact count: Free (2,000 contacts), Startup at $17/month (5,000), Webinar at $47/month (10,000) and Unlimited at $97/month. No plan takes a cut of sales, but the Free plan stops taking new payments once it reaches USD 10,000 in lifetime sales and a 3-day upgrade window passes, and the lower tiers have tight caps on tags, automation rules and funnels.
notFor: Stores with large physical-product catalogs (product variants are capped at 50, 100 and 250 on Free, Startup and Webinar)
Businesses that want built-in SMS without opening and paying for a separate Twilio account
Buyers who need a refund window, because subscriptions are non-refundable
pros: 0% transaction fee on every plan, including Free
Unlimited email sends on every plan, including Free
Free plan with 2,000 contacts and no credit card required
Unlimited assistant (staff) accounts on every plan at no extra cost
Annual billing is 10× the monthly price, and annual or Unlimited plans include free done-for-you migration
Unlimited sub-accounts, each with the same limits as the main plan
cons: Free plan stops accepting new payments after USD 10,000 in lifetime sales plus a 3-day upgrade window
Startup caps you at 10 tags, 10 automation rules and 10 funnels
Going over a paid plan's limits triggers an automatic upgrade after a 3-day notice
Subscriptions are non-refundable, and downgrades go through support
Evergreen webinars start on the $47/month Webinar plan
SMS needs your own Twilio account, billed separately by Twilio
